title: Television control experiment (30 subjects, 4 classes, 31 EEG ch)
description: A P300-based brain-computer interface dataset for television control comprising EEG recordings from 30 healthy subjects performing a visual oddball task. The dataset includes 31-channel EEG data sampled at 500 Hz with target and non-target event classifications (2 classes), designed to evaluate BCI performance for home appliance control applications in a laboratory setting.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 31-channel actiCHamp system (Brain Products) at 500 Hz sampling rate with linked mastoid reference and active sensors. Participants performed a P300 oddball paradigm with visual flash stimuli presented on an LCD display at 750 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. Each subject completed one session with 50 training and 30 testing blocks, generating target and non-target event classifications over a 1-second trial interval.
